title.narrative: Ethiopia Education Transformation Operation for Learning

description.narrative: The Ethiopia Education Transformation Operation for Learning (ETOL) aims to increase equitable access and improve learning outcomes in pre-primary and primary education. To achieve this, the operation focuses on two interconnected results areas (RAs). The first RA focuses on transforming teaching and learning by enhancing teacher preparation and continuous professional development, providing high-quality learning materials, and strengthening school leadership. The second RA focuses on transforming schools into effective learning centers through expanded and improved school infrastructure, inclusive education support, and a targeted school grants system linked to School Improvement Plans (SIPs). Additionally, ETOL seeks to strengthen the education system and builds institutional capacity, with particular emphasis on the rollout of education technology (EdTech) solutions to enhance both system management and classroom practices. The operation combines national-level reform and capacity building with regionally tailored resource allocation, ensuring that all interventions contribute to improved learning outcomes and equitable access across Ethiopia.An Additional Financing (AF) is proposed to expand the scope of the parent operation to reach refugee preprimary and primary schools outside of the national education system and host community schools. This will be achieved through: (a) the provision of a minimum service support package to refugee and host community schools to strengthen pathways for equitable access, enhance teacher quality and availability, improve school leadership, and ensure adequate provision of teaching and learning materials so that schools progressively meet national standards; (b) the integration of primary refugee schools, which often include preprimary education, into the national education system; and (c) scaling up existing activities under the parent operation to support to refugee and host community schools.
